title.narrative: Climate-smart fodder production through land restoration in Niger

description.narrative: The project focused on locally-led land restoration and forage management to support sustainability of the programme. The programme directly contributed to strenghened climate resilience of targeted communities by promoting agricultural practices that reduce reliance on single species for fodder production while creating new income generating activities. Hence, with support from the programme, targeted communties have achieved increased financial independence and improved food security - especially during the lean season.
